name: Caroline Marigold
original_name: キャロライン・マリーゴールド
source:
Caroline is the current Beltina and an excellent one. Her kind and affectionate nature is loved by everyone on the island. She’s slightly clumsy and a bit of an airhead like when she waved at [url=/c10696]Kazuki[/url] on top of a windy bridge wearing only a skirt. Even so, Caroline shows a sharp intuition and wisdom beyond her years when it concerns the feelings of others.

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=4098&cpage=1#comment-107931]m3rryweather's review[/url]]
